label: Backward Euler inductor
subgoals: Discretize the inductor equation with a backward difference
Read the conductance as h over L
Carry the previous current as the history source

label: Trapezoidal inductor conductance
subgoals: Average the inductor voltage over the step
Isolate the coefficient of the new voltage
Rewrite it as the diagonal of the inductor branch row

label: The trapezoidal history current
subgoals: Multiply the previous voltage by h over two L
Stamp the sum as the inductor's history source
